jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India team

Location:
Remote (India)
About the Company

A venture-backed SaaS company is building out its founding India engineering team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire an early Machine Learning Engineer. You will be one of the first ML hires shaping how the product uses models from the ground up, with direct input into what gets built next. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.
Role Overview

As a founding Machine Learning Engineer, you will move fast from prototype to shipped feature, owning models end-to-end in a small, high-ownership team with minimal process overhead.
Key Responsibilities

Rapid Model Shipping

Prototype and ship ML-powered features directly into the product, often within days rather than sprints
Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs or smaller models for the company's specific use case
Make pragmatic build-vs-buy calls between in-house models and third-party APIs

Ownership & Scale

Set up lightweight but solid infrastructure for training, evaluation, and deployment as the product scales
Instrument usage and model performance to guide the next iteration
Work directly with the founders and product team to prioritise what ML should solve next

Ideal Candidate Profile

2 to 6 years in applied machine learning, with at least one product shipped to real users
Comfortable working with ambiguity, thin specs, and fast-changing priorities
Strong Python skills and familiarity with modern LLM and ML tooling
Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, or prompt-based systems in production
Prior experience at an early-stage startup or as a founding engineer
A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field

What We Offer

A founding ML seat with outsized ownership on a fast-moving SaaS product
Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
Direct, daily collaboration with founders and early product decisions
One application considered for this and future matched roles

Hiring Process

HR Screening → Take-Home Build → Founder Round → Culture Fit

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Agentic AI / GenAI
jobs.description:
Senior AI Product Engineer – Full Stack
Location:
Remote – India
Experience:
7–11 years
Employment:
Full-time
About the Role
Traction is an Australian AI product studio building AI-powered products and solutions for businesses across professional services, financial services, government and technology.
We are hiring our first Senior Engineer in India
. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product engineering role
where you will own solutions from understanding the business problem through development, deployment and production.
Key Responsibilities
Understand client business problems and identify opportunities where AI can create real value.
Translate ambiguous requirements into practical product and technical solutions.
Design and build end-to-end software products
, including data models, APIs, interfaces and AI workflows.
Build and deploy AI/LLM-powered applications
such as agents, RAG systems and tool-calling workflows.
Own applications in production and continuously improve them based on real-world usage.
Make key technical decisions around architecture, build vs. buy and implementation approach.
Work closely with clients and senior stakeholders and communicate technical decisions clearly.
Use AI coding agents effectively as part of the development workflow.

What We're Looking For
7–11 years of software engineering experience
, with strong hands-on development experience.
Strong full-stack / product engineering
background with experience building software end-to-end.
Proven experience building and shipping production systems
used by real users.
Hands-on experience building and deploying production AI/LLM applications
.
Experience with AI agents, RAG, tool calling or similar LLM-based workflows
.
Strong practical experience with coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor
.
Excellent engineering judgement, including the ability to identify and validate incorrect AI-generated code or output.
Ability to take ownership, work independently and challenge unclear or incorrect requirements.
Strong problem-solving and product thinking skills.
Ability to quickly understand new businesses, domains and customer problems.
Excellent spoken and written English
with confidence in client-facing discussions.

Technology
The team primarily works with TypeScript, Python and React
, along with modern AI/LLM technologies.
Strong engineers from other technology backgrounds can also be considered if they demonstrate strong product engineering capability and the ability to learn quickly.
Work Arrangement
Fully remote – anywhere in India
Full-time role
Minimum 4 hours of overlap with Australian working hours

In practice, the role generally requires availability from around 8 AM IST
